name: Manabi-aid Co.,Ltd.
summary: Manabi-aid Co.,Ltd. plans, develops, and provides online educational services in Japan. It offers AID master for supporting tutoring school management with video lessons and learning management functions; AID master for school, a customized service for medium-sized to large cram schools; AID for enterprise, such as video conversion of paper-based teaching materials, including reference books, workbooks, and textbooks, as well as construction of video distribution platforms, production of video manuals, and production of promotional animations. The company also provides consulting services and educational institution; and manages cram schools. Manabi-aid Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Bunkyo, Japan.
